name: 01-warm-evolution
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE homepage prototype for estimador.pt, Portuguese public data and synthetic population research platform. Landscape 1440x1100-ish composition. Real functional website aesthetic, not magazine, moodboard, poster or presentation. Compact header: simple pine monochrome horizontal interval-with-whiskers symbol and off-centre hollow dot, bold lowercase estimador.pt, navigation Início População Economia Desporto Eleições Sobre. Manrope-like modern sans-serif typography throughout, no serif. Keep paper #f5f3ea page and pine #234c40 text/buttons. Layout fixed across concepts: dominant population panel two thirds width at left, football narrow panel right, smaller economy and election panels below. Thin borders, radius16, generous but NOT huge whitespace. Population text left and architectural cutaway art right. Exact title "Um país de pessoas." subcopy "Explora a população sintética. Uma base para investigar e preparar microssimulações." Main button "Explorar população", quiet link "Dados e métodos", small status "Demonstração". Football compact stadium art, title "Quem fica com o título?", simple outlined field control preview no fabricated numerical data, action "Experimentar resultados". Lower panels small image next to text: ECONOMIA "Para lá do número." action "Explorar indicadores"; ELEIÇÕES "Dos votos aos lugares." action "Ver arquivo". No made-up charts, percentages, dates or results. Every section gets a recognisable illustration in a unified family. Portuguese architecture WITHOUT tourist clichés, flags, excessive red roofs. Preserve warm humanity of charming current cutaway-house illustrations: people reading, working, family cooking, a shop, stadium and civic assembly. Not abstract symbols alone. UI text must stay crisp distinct from artwork. Entire screenshot visible, no device frame.
DIRECTION 1: WARM ARCHITECTURAL EVOLUTION. Closest to current warm storybook miniature scenes but refined into clean architectural editorial drawing. Flat front-on 3-storey cutaway home with 5 friendly human figures, simplified furniture, a few shutters and one terracotta roof; very restrained flat shading, clear silhouettes, no grain or 3D glossy rendering. Stadium oval built of clean shapes, shop awning and assembly arc use same geometry. Colour system: dominant sage #a9c3b1, architectural warm limestone #e8dfce, clay accent #ca8e75, all anchored with pine. NO lavender, pink candy coral or mustard yellow. Use sage generously, clay sparingly, natural varied skin tones. A tiny geometric corner motif made of an arch and square borrows exactly those colours. It should feel warmer and quieter yet clearer than multicolour pastel art.

DIRECTION 2: THE LIVING ARCHITECTURAL MOSAIC. Distinctive flat vector-like art where the mosaic becomes actual architecture: quarter circles become rooflines, semicircles arch windows, rounded rectangles rooms, small discs heads. Five human figures clearly inhabiting a playful frontal cutaway apartment with reading, laptop, dining scenes. Geometry is clean, precise but not childish, no textures, gradients, roof-tile detail, tiny foliage or heavy black outlines. Align flat modular facades and rooms beautifully. Football is an elegant simplified stadium using same circles and arches; economy is a modular cafe-shop facade; assembly fan of seats with ballot shape. Palette dominant soft mineral blue #abc2ca, supportive muted sage #afc7b8, small apricot clay #d8a487. All plus pine, cream and natural skin tones. No lilac, no mustard, no four equal colour quadrants. Use pine lines/details enough to anchor figures. Tiny architectural mosaic accent integrated into panel composition. Keep human charm and real subject readability. This is the recommended midpoint, distinctive website not a museum diagram.
